name: 習慣の休止と保管と削除
prompt:
Edit Image1 LH13-0022 with one targeted official-style correction. Change ONLY utility palette and title weight. Preserve all original glyph geometry as governed by ORIGINAL Image2, layout, card, dividers, word-for-word Japanese copy, helper wrapping, spacing, count of3rows and colors of destructive row. Image3 shows established REGULAR title typography; it is SECONDARY to original for glyph geometry.
1) Pause bars and archive glyph must be SLATE#526173, not blue. Their circular fields must be neutral near-white#F7F7F7, not blue-tinted. No gradients on glyphs.
2) ALL three titles must be Meiryo REGULAR400 at logical14px/24px with0tracking, matching Image3. Reduce the heavy/bold strokes visibly; never bold. Helper copy remains Meiryo Regular12px/16px with0tracking. Keep hierarchy by size, not heavier title weight.
3) Delete title/glyph remain restrained coral-red#C9424A for destructive meaning; helper stays gray. Make its tiny circular field near-white rather than pink if doing so supports consistent quiet utility grouping.
Exact text invariant:「一時停止」「新しい予定をしばらく止めます。」「保管する」「記録を残して一覧から移します。」「習慣を削除」「習慣と関連する記録を削除します。」. Original pause two bars, archive lid/body/slot, trash handle/lid/3interior strokes remain unchanged. No other changes, added controls or content. Pure white canvas/card, fine neutral outline and soft shadow retained. No green action. Raster candidate.

Three action titles have reduced regular-style weight; helpers quiet. Delete glyph remains semantic red while its title is ink rather than prompted red; accepted final accent on glyph only, supported by explicit delete wording. Original lower English helper occluded; existing Japanese preserved. Native exact font metrics/art pixels and real actions unproved.
